The lower body, legs and feet are entirely OUTSIDE the frame and are never shown. There is no sign, no board, no plaque and no lettering anywhere. The scene is a painted tableau — a frozen moment, not an action. Nothing moves; this is a still painting.

Cut to mid framing within the crop — the turned sorrowful face beneath dark hair.

Cut to insert — the lean ribcage and sternum, each bone defined.

Cut to macro detail — the shoulder where the arm meets the chest, drawn taut.

Cut to mid framing — the bare forearm extended up to the dark beam.

Return to the opening framed crop — the turned face and bare chest.

End hold on the turned face against the dark ground.

Camera:
- crop-based reframing only within the existing close image
- no invented movement, no widening beyond the existing frame

Quiet, reverent, the stillness of a body given over.

No added elements. No full-body view. No cross sign or lettering.
